prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Cao Pi from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the first emperor of Wei, who outdid her siblings even with the brush. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour, skin tone, costume and weapon are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: cool literary talent and imperial ambition, the first Wei emperor's regalia, a poet's brush.

World (fixed): Cao Wei in northern China, around 200–235 AD: the walled capitals of Xuchang, Ye and Luoyang, rammed-earth ramparts and tiled watchtowers, black-and-navy banners over vast northern plains, armoured cavalry, bronze ritual vessels and lacquered halls. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) layered laced lamellar armor, big heavy beast-head pauldrons and armored skirts to the knees — a broad, weighty general's silhouette; 2) layered trailing court regalia with a tall crown, long hanging sashes and jade pendants — a ceremonial, stately silhouette; 3) a great war cape spreading from the shoulders to the ankles as the main shape, lamellar armor beneath; 4) a lamellar breastplate above, many layers of silk skirt flaring wide below the waist — firm above, flowing below; 5) a large phoenix crown with hanging bead strands and a weighty ceremonial robe — the headdress is the main shape. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her legend, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like feathers, scales or petals, a hem or sleeve cut into a motif from her story. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Weapon (fixed — ours): an imperial brush of jade.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): polished copper-red hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white.

Rank (fixed): she is a ruler — her costume must read her sovereign rank at first glance: layered, richly ornate and regal, with flagship-card detail, fine engraving and jewellery, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour and skin tone), another costume shape from the list with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; a banner or seal may carry a single faction character, no other text; no logo or watermark.

Detailed design for this image:
Choose silhouette 5: a large phoenix crown with hanging bead strands above a weighty ceremonial robe. The sleeves are constructed from stepped overlapping silk leaves like a spreading stack of poetry slips, navy outer fabric and ivory undersides, cold silver fittings and black lacquer edges. Polished copper-red hair worn long in loose side-swept waves under the crown, fair skin, clear blue-grey eyes, softly rounded cheeks and a short midface, a relaxed confident smile. Stand front-facing at the top of a late-Han tiled courtyard stair, one full-scale jade imperial brush held diagonally downward in front of her, free hand slightly lifted with visible fingers. Deep open neckline and bare upper arms, a straight high slit showing one leg without lifting the knee; intimate areas covered. Regal jewellery and jade pendants, no other people. Full bust, narrow waist, realistic hips and thighs. Soft key light and a clean strong rim, dewy body highlights, soft natural face.

generation.submitted_prefix: 아래 지시문을 고치지 말고 그대로 그려라.
